about:
Wood World of Texas LLC operates from a single location in Dallas, Texas. The business is run by Craig Fyock, who serves as the primary contact and authors the company’s blog posts. The company emphasizes its authenticity as the original Wood World of Texas site, warning against imitation websites.

The company stocks a wide range of woodworking materials and tools, including domestic and imported lumber (knotty alder, European beech, plywood, veneer, natural-edge slabs), finishing products from brands such as Hampshire Sheen, Chestnut, and Jimmy Clewes, and power tools from Metabo, Skil, DeWalt, and Rikon. It also supplies knife-making kits, gun grips and accessories, turning kits, and outdoor tools like hatchets and tomahawks. Value-added services include sanding and the grading of knotty alder for high-end rustic applications in doors, moldings, and cabinets. Hands-on classes in knife making, cutting boards, and charcuterie boards are offered on-site.

Customers include hobbyist woodworkers, professional cabinetmakers, door manufacturers, knife makers, gunsmiths, and woodturners. The product assortment targets both small-scale craft production and individual makers, with specific lines for pen turning, game calls, and kitchen knife blanks.

Wood World of Texas differentiates itself by importing hard-to-find product lines and developing exclusive finishing products to its own specifications, while maintaining a single brick-and-mortar location to ensure direct customer service. The company also highlights its hands-on educational offerings as a community-focused distinction.
